card.name: The word of after quantity nouns
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after a noun naming an amount or portion, such as layer, line, bag, bank, string or units. It is most common in "Apply a thin layer of" in dosing directions.

modes.label: Thin layer of
modes.description: "of" after "layer" in instructions to apply a topical product.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Apply a thin layer<< of>> VTAMA cream to affected areas once daily

modes.label: Other amount nouns
modes.description: "of" after a container, collection or measure noun in general text or in dose text.
modes.example: ously 300 to 500 mL/hr of 10% dextrose solution containing 10 to 20 units<< of>> crystalline insulin per 100

card.plain: It marks the small word "of" after a noun for an amount, just before the thing being measured is named.
